name: Before / after
description: Two photos side by side, labelled, with a headline and a button under them. For a makeover, a repair, a clean-up, a renovation or a result.

headline.label: Headline
headline.description: The statement under the photos. Use | to break the line, e.g. SAME CHAIR.|NEW YOU.

headline_accent.label: Accent words
headline_accent.description: Words of the headline shown in your brand colour, exactly as they appear in it. Leave empty for none.

caption.label: Caption
caption.description: A line about the work, e.g. Balayage and cut by Mia, 2 hours. Leave empty for none.

cta.label: Button
cta.description: The button's words, e.g. Book now. Leave empty for none.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: Your account handle, top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

before.label: Before photo
before.description: The before shot, no words in it: the same subject and framing as the after. Upload one or pick one from the Library.

after.label: After photo
after.description: The after shot, no words in it: the same subject and framing as the before. Upload one or pick one from the Library.

sample_data.headline: SAME CHAIR.|NEW YOU.
sample_data.caption: Balayage and cut by Mia, 2 hours.
